ambient: Another item is added to the accounting, quietly.
Your heart does something irregular, and the accounting doesn't pause for it.
description: A long, level room with the whole of it laid out: everything you did, arranged in a way that makes the pattern obvious. Nobody here is angry with you. That's the hard part. It's simply all here, and it's simply all yours.
name: The Accounting

looks: Obvious, now it's laid out. You did the same thing many times.
It goes back further than you had been counting from.
There's one decision near the start doing most of the work.
objects.name: the pattern

looks: It's here with the rest, at the same size as the rest.
It waits for you to say something and doesn't rush you.
Seen from here it's small and it changed everything.
objects.name: the thing you did

weather: The room is the temperature of a waiting room and has been all night.
